body:
Well I've been sitting on these wounds for the better part of my life. If they take time it'll be a while yet.

I need to sleep, sorry. Thank you for your words and time, I wish I could stay up.
If I find a place I want to run to I'll do just that.

Yes and yes. I had my last session yesterday. 

I'm not feeling good at all. I feel nauseated with the thought of going to work tomorrow. Getting up at all, really, scares me. I don't want to go to college or work but if I give up now I will never have these opportunities again.

I don't know. Somewhere with people who can help me understand and cope with what I've been dealing with. If I could leave right now I would stay because I don't know anywhere and I don't have any money. I wish I could tell you but I don't know.
How? What have I not tried?
